distribution: 福建建瓯、南靖，广东南雄，海南，江西上清。
en: The soldier has a head intermediate between round and square, widest across the antennal sockets, with a pale T-shaped mark on the dorsum. The postclypeus is raised and about one third as long as wide. Antennae have 14 segments, the second longer than the fourth and the third longer than the second. A few short hairs lie on the abdominal dorsum and longer ones scatter over the venter. The pronotum is erect in front, equal in size to the rear part.
soldier: 兵蚁头形介于圆形与方形之间，最宽处在触角窝一带，头背淡色 T 形斑明显。后唇基隆起，长约当宽的三分之一。触角十四节，第二节长于第四节，第三节长于第二节。腹部背面有少许短毛，腹面散生较长的毛。前胸背板前半部直立，与后半部大小相等，前缘中央凹陷。
worker: 工蚁头部深黄，毛被稀疏，腹部淡黄白。
